observations.says: from when the soup was served on Thursday until the joint was carried in, Captain Voss was not in the study
from when the soup was served on Thursday until the joint was carried in, nobody but Captain Voss was in the hall
from when the soup was served on Thursday until the guests had gone, everyone but Clara Marlow, Captain Voss and Miss Pym was in the dining-room
from when the joint was carried in until the guests had gone, the hall was watched by nobody
when the dessert was served, Miss Pym was not in the dining-room

from when the soup was served on Thursday until the guests had gone, George Marlow was in the dining-room; from when the soup was served on Thursday until the guests had gone, Hannah was in the dining-room
from when the joint was carried in until the guests had gone, Captain Voss was in the dining-room
when the fish was served, Captain Voss was not in the dining-room
